How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NEERI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II recruitment is 27th August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.Sc. or Integrated Masters in Life Sciences with 2 years of experience, or an M.E./M. Tech or Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-II position is 35 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, though not detailed here.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 28,000 to Rs. 35,000, potentially with HRA depending on the specific pay scale.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-II position will be based on an Online Interview. Candidates are advised to prepare accordingly.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Associate-II position at CSIR NEERI is contractual, meaning the appointment will be for a fixed tenure.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the CSIR-National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR NEERI), located in Nagpur, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q9. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-II post in this recruitment drive by CSIR NEERI.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and the online application link will be available in the "Important Links" section of this article. You can also visit the official website of CSIR NEERI.
